situation: Plumber was booked for 8am to fix our leaking water heater. I took the morning off, it's 10 now and nobody showed or called. The company is Apex Plumbing, the scheduler was Tina.
reply: Hi Tina, Apex was booked for 8am today to repair the water heater at 45 Linden St, and nobody arrived or called. I took the morning off for this. Can you confirm a new time by end of day tomorrow? If I don't hear back by then, I'll book another plumber.
note: Factual and dated, with the consequence stated once, not threatened.

situation: 闺蜜最近三次约饭都是当天下午才说来不了，这周六又约了看展。我不想闹僵，但真的有点累了。
reply: 我很喜欢跟你出来玩，但最近三次约好的饭都是当天取消的，我这边就有点不敢提前安排了。不是生气，就是想找个对你更轻松的方式。周六要不改成下午在你家附近喝杯咖啡？或者你说说什么安排更适合你。
note: 用"三次"而不是"你总是"，对方就没法争论；说的是你会怎么调整，不是给她下通牒。

situation: I completely forgot a 9am discovery call with a potential client, Amanda, who runs a group of dental clinics. She just emailed 'Did I have the wrong time?' I'm a freelance web designer.
reply: Hi Amanda, you had the right time. I missed our 9am call and I'm sorry, you set aside the start of your morning and I wasn't there. Could we do Thursday at 9 or Friday at 1? I'll bring a first-pass review of your online booking page so the time is well spent.
note: Take the blame off her first, then offer two slots so she doesn't do the rescheduling work.

situation: I'm a private math tutor. A parent, Mrs. Alvarez, cancelled her son's session 2 hours before the start, second time this month. My policy, which she signed, is 24 hours' notice or the full $60 is charged. She just texted that charging for a cancellation is ridiculous.
reply: Hi Mrs. Alvarez, I understand it's frustrating, especially in a busy week. The 24-hour policy is in the agreement you signed in September, and I apply it to every family, so today's $60 charge stands. I'd like to keep Mateo's momentum going before his unit test: I have Thursday at 5pm or Saturday at 10am open this week. Which suits you better?
note: When a client argues the fee: restate the policy once, apply it evenly, and move straight to rebooking. Waiving it for the loudest parent teaches everyone else.

situation: 朋友介绍的相亲，约了今晚7点在一家叫山海小馆的餐厅见面。现在7点25了，对方还没到，也没发消息。我不想显得很生气，也不想一直干等。
reply: 你好，我已经到山海小馆了，坐在靠窗的位置。路上还顺利吧？我等到7点45，要是今天赶不过来也没关系，我们改天再约。
note: First meeting, one-off: assume good faith, state your cut-off time, and leave an easy way to rebook.

situation: I'm meeting a new client, Victor, at his office at 2pm for a project kickoff. The Jubilee line is suspended and I'll be about 20 minutes late. It's 1:40 now.
reply: Hi Victor, the Jubilee line is suspended and I'm going to be about 20 minutes late, so around 2:20. Sorry to eat into your afternoon. If that squeezes you, I can do the kickoff by phone at 2 instead and we meet in person next week. Whichever is easier for you.
note: Warn before the start time, not after, with a real ETA and an option that protects their schedule.

situation: Mon amie Claire arrive toujours avec 30 à 40 minutes de retard. On a réservé un resto vendredi 2 octobre à 20h. Je ne veux pas me fâcher, mais je ne veux plus attendre seule devant une carafe d'eau.
reply: J'ai réservé chez Paulette vendredi à 20h ! Je te préviens gentiment : à 20h15 je commande, que tu sois là ou pas, comme ça je ne reste pas devant une assiette vide. Hâte de te voir !
note: Dire ce que tu vas faire, pas ce qu'elle doit faire, et le dire avant le dîner plutôt qu'après 40 minutes d'attente.

situation: In August I told my friend Megan her last-minute cancelling was getting to me, and we agreed to try short weekday coffees. She's cancelled two of those since, the latest an hour before today's. I'm done booking ahead with her, but I don't want to end the friendship.
reply: No stress at all, hope your day calms down. I'm going to stop booking things in advance for now, it's easier on both of us. But if you're ever free last minute, text me and I'll come if I can.
note: After naming the pattern once, you change how you plan, not the friendship. Say it once, without heat, and don't list the cancellations again.

situation: Sou personal trainer. O Felipe, aluno novo, tinha treino comigo hoje às 7h no Parque da Cidade e não apareceu nem avisou. Esperei até 7h30. Nosso contrato diz que falta sem aviso de 12 horas é cobrada, mas foi a primeira vez.
reply: Oi, Felipe, tudo bem? Tínhamos treino hoje às 7h no Parque da Cidade e te esperei até 7h30. Se aconteceu alguma coisa, sem problema. Posso te encaixar na quinta, 1º de outubro, às 7h, no mesmo lugar. Só lembrando que, pelo nosso contrato, falta sem aviso de 12 horas é cobrada normalmente a partir da próxima.
note: Falta profissional: fato com horário, uma opção concreta para remarcar e a regra para a próxima vez, dita uma vez e sem ameaça.

situation: I was supposed to meet my sister Nadia at Central station on Sunday to help with her two suitcases after her trip. I overslept, she waited 40 minutes and ended up paying €35 for a taxi. I've been avoiding texting her because I feel terrible.
reply: Nadia, I left you waiting at Central for 40 minutes on Sunday with two suitcases, and I'm really sorry. I overslept, which is no excuse. You gave up your time and paid for a taxi you shouldn't have needed, so I've just sent you the €35. Can I take you to dinner on Friday, my treat, and hear about the trip properly?
note: When you're the no-show: name it with the specifics, own it without a 'but', cover their real cost, and put a dated fix on the table so she doesn't do the rescheduling.

situation: I told my friend Sam that three of our last four plans got cancelled on the day and suggested weekday coffees near her office instead. She replied 'wow, didn't realise you were keeping a tally.' I don't want a fight.
reply: I'm not keeping score to punish you, promise. I'd rather say it than quietly stop inviting you, because I like seeing you. Let's try the coffee idea: Wednesday at 12:30 near yours? If that doesn't suit, tell me what would.
note: When they get defensive about the pattern, restate the intent once, don't argue the count, and move straight to a concrete plan.
